# NEXUS CORTEX Life Cycle — zero-entropy-lab

WorkflowHub. Published: 2026-11-08. 0 citations.

## Abstract

Historical executable generation of the NEXUS CORTEX lifecycle workflow for the zero-entropy-lab research software lineage, recorded from repository state 12287364d5915b4e51a6146996d6d8a95d547c22 on 2026-10-07. The workflow implements a graph-based, bounded research lifecycle with read-only validation and guarded application paths. It validates runtime contracts and active ledgers, harvests and projects approved external evidence, canonicalizes the active graph, rebuilds and ingests memory, verifies graph and hash-chain integrity, produces bounded lifecycle projections, checks the permitted write boundary and repository world-line, and applies only a stable and meaningful candidate. This WorkflowHub record preserves an externally registered historical workflow generation. The canonical implementation history remains in the source Git repository; the corresponding AGI record stores identity, verification and recovery metadata rather than a second executable copy.

URL: https://archive.softwareheritage.org/api/1/origin/https://github.com/lostlight530/welcome-to-github/visit/latest/

/api/1/origin/https://github.com/lostlight530/welcome-to-github/visit/latest/ – Software Heritage archive 

Get information about the latest visit of a software origin.

#### Request

```
GET https://archive.softwareheritage.org/api/1/origin/https://github.com/lostlight530/welcome-to-github/visit/latest/
```

##### Body

```
{
    "date": "2026-10-24T15:41:45.044000+00:00",
    "metadata": {},
    "origin": "https://github.com/lostlight530/welcome-to-github",
    "origin_url": "https://archive.softwareheritage.org/api/1/origin/https://github.com/lostlight530/welcome-to-github/get/",
    "snapshot": "371992368a1988590993dcb2195a1c7397a33290",
    "snapshot_url": "https://archive.softwareheritage.org/api/1/snapshot/371992368a1988590993dcb2195a1c7397a33290/",
    "status": "full",
    "type": "git",
    "visit": 4
}
```

| URL | Allowed Methods |
| --- | --- |
| https://archive.softwareheritage.org/api/1/origin/ (origin_url) /visit/latest/ | GET, HEAD, OPTIONS |

#### Arguments

origin_url (str)
: a software origin URL

#### Query parameters

require_snapshot (boolean)
: if true, only return a visit with a snapshot

visit_type (str)
: if provided, filter visits by type

#### Request headers

Accept
: the requested response content type, either application/json (default) or application/yaml

#### Response headers

Content-Type
: this depends on Accept header of request

#### Returns

object
: an object containing the following keys:

> - date (string): ISO8601/RFC3339 representation of the visit date (in UTC)
> - origin (str): the origin canonical url
> - origin_url (string): link to get information about the origin
> - snapshot (string): the snapshot identifier of the visit (may be null if status is not full).
> - snapshot_url (string): link to /api/1/snapshot/ in order to get information about the snapshot of the visit (may be null if status is not full).
> - status (string): status of the visit (either full, partial or ongoing)
> - type (string): visit type for the origin
> - visit (number): the unique identifier of the visit

#### HTTP status codes

200
: no error

404
: requested origin or visit cannot be found in the archive
